entities.name: Johannes Joachim Degenhardt
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Johannes Joachim Degenhardt was the Roman Catholic
Archbishop of Paderborn (Germany) from 1974 until his death in 2002. He was named Cardinal in 2001.
